title: Ordinary and derived normalization records for integral support
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l, a compactification c of f:X→Y, and the strict étale support, Brown adjunction, finite evaluation and transport data S,G,H,D of [lem-pur-brown-tower-finite-site-comparison]. Use the quotient-coordinate equivalence of [def-pur-adic-exceptional-system-realization] and systemSupport of [def-pur-semilinear-compact-support-coefficient-transport]. Define coordinates to be its ordinary derived equivalence. Define PushNormalized by identity on every underlying section after rightEvaluation and rightUnderlying. An Ordinary record consists of open and proper direct-image comparison isomorphisms satisfying PushNormalized, the open inverse-image comparison satisfying its ordinary Hom-transpose equation, and the extension-by-zero comparison satisfying its Hom-transpose equation. Given an Ordinary record B, a Derived record consists of its termwise open-extension and proper-push chain maps with the prescribed components, the open derived comparison satisfying the exact localization representative equation, and the proper derived comparison satisfying the universal right-derived-unit equation. A Normalized record is an Ordinary record B together with a Derived record over B. These are records of specified comparisons and their equations; this definition asserts no existence.
